description:
Job Title: Web Application Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: None 
 
* * * 
 
 
 The Opportunity:  
 CACI is currently looking for Web Application Developer, with a focus on Salesforce to join our CACI idt. Team supporting leading next-generation IT solutions that help defense, intelligence, and federal civilian agencies overcome diverse, complex mission challenges to keep our nation safe. As the Web Developer you will provide dedicated cloud systems delivery support tied to ensuring workflows evolve to meet CACI’s mission needs and support cross-application integrations, workflow modernization.
 Additionally, you will translate mission needs using experience working with underlying internal CACI end users who directly work with the application web developer to benefit from SaaS and other licensed products directly supported by the developer. 

 Responsibilities:  
 Use and extend applications using .NET Framework and C# development and sustainment
 Automate business processes utilizing Salesforce native tools such as Workflow, Process Builder and Flow
 Extend the capability of Salesforce utilizing Salesforce development environment to build triggers, components, pages and integrations
 Interact with the SaaS and on prem workflow tools, cross-system integrations and database REST API, and related application communications
 Handle all basic administrative functions including database support, application sustaining integration and configuration maintenance, reports and dashboards, workflows and other routine tasks
 Complete regular internal system audits and prepare for upgrades with other system administrative team members
 Create deployment packages to move code to various environments from CACI DevOps platform to end production systems
 Manage Salesforce data feeds and other integrations to Cloud operated platforms supporting department operations
 Coordinate the evaluation, scope and completion of new development requests
 Work with our internal user team to identify changes, new requirements, and targets for next phases in usage lifecycles of specialized applications to support administrative, development, and change management activities
 Work independently with members of the CACI user community to define and document development requirements
 Assist with training of new localized CACI users, and related documentation tied to sustaining the usage of the supported Salesforce platform needs
 
 Qualifications: 
 Required:  
 College degree (B.S.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Management Systems, or a related discipline. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of degree.
 5 or more years of professional software development or experience.
 2 or more years of experience with Salesforce.com developer, prefer skills in independently debugging existing code bases and taking necessary corrective actions
 2 or more years of experience directly with .NET Framework, and related C# experience
 Strong data management abilities, and experience with system APIs and integrations, ideally with Salesforce or other financial organizational business systems
 Experience with cloud hosted service management, and operations of service integrations, preferably AWS
 Strong understanding of Salesforce.com best practices and functionality
 Strong understanding of the platform, with the ability to build custom components to meet user requirements 
 Thrive working independently debugging existing code bases and taking necessary corrective actions and ensure workability with end user
 Work onsite in either Chantilly or Reston, VA
 
 Desired: 
 Relevant Salesforce augmenting certifications, Salesforce.com Admin (ADM201 and ADM211) certified, Salesforce.com Platform App Builder certified, Salesforce.com Platform Developer I certified, or Salesforce.com Platform Developer II certified
 Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills
 Excellent project support and delivery skills and a positive attitude
 Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests, and manage laterally and upwards
 Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills
 Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
 Communicate effectively at all levels of the organization
  
 
 
 
- 
 

 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$75,200-$158,100 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
